label: TP
reason: Both alerts represent genuine vulnerabilities. Alert 1 (insecure-randomness): java.util.Random is cryptographically weak for session token generation, enabling potential prediction attacks. Alert 2 (xss): User-controlled cookie values (name/value) flow directly into HTML output without sanitization, allowing script injection. Neither has effective mitigation.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random for session token generation - cryptographically weak PRNG
User-provided cookie values rendered in HTML response without HTML encoding
